latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the literature-review skill, enabling systematic, professional literature reviews with integrated visualizations.

- Supports multi-database search (PubMed, arXiv, bioRxiv, Semantic Scholar, etc.) with systematic aggregation and deduplication.
- Guides users through structured phases: planning, search, screening, data extraction, quality assessment, and synthesis.
- Enforces inclusion of at least 1–2 AI-generated schematics (PRISMA diagrams, flowcharts, etc.) via the scientific-schematics skill.
- Produces professionally formatted markdown and PDF documents with verified citations in multiple styles (APA, Nature, Vancouver, etc.).
- Integrates with other scientific skills for advanced database access and citation management.
